title: Storylets Registry File (storylets.json)
description: Schema for the storylets registry. Per ADR-0013, storylets are stored in a single Registry File. Simple storylets are pure data inline. Complex storylets escape to scripts and content files via {script: ...} or {file: ...} references. Storylets read world state via typed precondition queries, score via salience expressions or scripts, and emit effects.

tier.description: Storylet tier. Major (rare, dramatic, multi-act), Minor (frequent, medium-impact), Flavor (ambient, common, low-impact). Per the Fractal Philosophy salience-tier convention.

preconditions.description: Queries that must all be true for this storylet to be eligible per narrative tick. Each query is validated against storylet_queries.schema.json#/$defs/Query.

salience.description: Inline expression (string, evaluated against the runtime world-state namespace per _common.schema.json#/$defs/RuntimeExpression) OR a script reference for complex salience computation.

effects.description: Inline declarative effect list OR a script reference for complex effects.

content.description: Inline content string OR a file reference for longer content.

cooldown.description: Minimum time before this storylet can fire again.
